note: Saint Lucia: a foreign national may not engage in any occupation without a valid work permit or exemption, and must work on its terms (Labour Act s. 317(1) and (2), Department of Labour notice). No days of work without it are named. OECS citizens work freely (the oecs list, first); other CARICOM artistes and musicians of the participating states on the Skills Certificate (the csme list).

sources.title: Government of Saint Lucia, Work permit requirement for employment of foreign nationals, mandatory
sources.said: According section 317 (1) & (2) of the Labour Act, a foreign national shall not engage in any occupation in Saint Lucia unless there is in force in relation to him or her a valid work permit or exemption, and he/she is employed in accordance with the terms and conditions specified.
